title: INHILLDAUGAR: annotated place-names along the Daugava, Latvia (Potsdam/Polish-German project, 2025)
describe: Place-names along the Daugava in Latvia with etymology and the century of their earliest documentary attestation where known (e.g. 13th-century chronicles, the 1557 register, Mellin 1798); names without a documented attestation are not dated.
datingLabel: century of the earliest documentary attestation
